queries.request: Across every repo I have checked out on this laptop, which local branches already had their pull requests merged on GitHub?
We transferred and renamed a few GitHub repositories last quarter. Find which of my local clones still point at the old names.
Give me one report covering all the repositories under my projects folder: dead worktrees, merged branches, anything that needs tidying. Don't touch anything.
Plenty of our PR branches are still sitting on origin after they merged, in several repos. List them per repository so I can see how bad it is.
Before I reimage this machine, sweep all my checkouts for leftover worktrees and branches that are safe to drop, and give me a plan I can run later.
Which of the repos in the org folder have worktree registrations pointing at directories that no longer exist?
Weekly hygiene pass over the whole set of checkouts, please: roll up per repo what's clean and what needs attention.
Branches named agent-3fa9c1 and claude/something are piling up on the remotes of a dozen repos. Show me where they are.
Scan the git repositories under the work folder and tell me which ones have stale branches or orphaned worktrees.
I juggle checkouts of about thirty services. Which ones have local branches I could delete because GitHub shows them merged?
Clean up the merged branches and clear the build caches in this repository.
Create a new worktree for the payments-retry branch so I can work on it in parallel.
My disk is almost full. Find temp files, stale lock files and partial downloads under my home directory.
Run this command on my desktop machine and tell me what it prints.
Watch my open pull requests and merge the ones whose checks are green.
Reset this one checkout to match origin/main exactly and throw away my local edits.
Delete node_modules and .venv folders across all my repos to free up space.
Before I shut the laptop, make sure nothing I worked on today is uncommitted or unpushed.
Write a .gitignore for this Python project.
Pull the latest main into every repo I have checked out.
